installNotes: Download the .7z archive, verify its SHA256 against the published SHA256SUMS, then extract the inner .qcow2.
Place the extracted .qcow2 at <vm-home>/images/kali-linux-2026.2-qemu-amd64.qcow2 (read-only golden image).
Each VM session gets a throwaway qcow2 overlay on top of the golden image; the golden image is never written to.
On first boot, run vm-runner/provision/install-guestd.sh inside the VM once to install the Infinity guest agent.
name: Kali Linux QEMU (amd64) — Infinity AI VM Runner golden image
source: Official Kali Linux pre-built virtual machine image (https://www.kali.org/get-kali/#kali-virtual-machines).
